BinaryDownload.description: Authenticated HTTP binary response. SDK metadata wrapper includes bytes/blob, Content-Type, ETag, RFC5987 filename and not_modified. Only authorized avatar304 is accepted.

AvatarUpload.description: Raw PNG/JPEG/WebP, at most2MiB; server sanitizes to JPEG.

description: Canonical wire DTOs. Unknown additive response fields are accepted. Exact domain decimals and unsafe integers remain strings.
